description: Nightly check daemon for exemptions past valid_until in mcp_exemptions table. Queries write_service for rows WHERE valid_until < NOW(). Marks expired exemptions (sets status='expired' or equivalent column). Emits audit_log entry for each expiry. Only touches mcp_exemptions. Runs as a standalone daemon with 60s heartbeat to service_health. Complements retention_sweeper for lifecycle management.
